en-US.author: Microsoft Corporation
en-US.description: The package manager for AI-Native Development.
en-US.longDescription:
An open-source, community-driven dependency manager for AI agents.
Think package.json, requirements.txt, or Cargo.toml — but for AI agent configuration.
en-US.name: APM – Agent Package Manager
